children: Sixteen of 18 Fed officials penciled in at least one more rate hike for this year in the central bank's so-called dot plot. That would take rates to just above 4%.
Chairman Kevin Warsh again declined to submit a projection.
This item is part of a Wall Street Journal live coverage event. The full stream can be found by searching P/WSJL (WSJ Live Coverage).
